description: Bar Slicer Plume is a list slicer that shows the weight of each value. Drop a column in Field and a measure in Measure (bars): every value gets a bar, its figure and its share of the total, so users see what they are about to filter before they click. The selection filters the whole report like the native slicer. FREE, NO WATERMARK - Measure bars between label and value, below the label or as row background; relative to the maximum or share of total - Accent-insensitive search with highlighted matches and "Select results" - Invert the selection, "Select all" row, selected values moved to the top - Multiple, Ctrl or single selection; Alt + click for only this value, Shift + click for a range - Sort by measure, label (natural sort), a separate "Sort by" measure or model order - Selection summary: "3 selected · 1.0M of 1.8M" - Values without data dimmed, grouped at the bottom or hidden - Number format, themes (Plume, report theme or custom), header, frame - Tooltips, context menu, bookmarks, sync slicers, keyboard navigation, screen readers, high contrast, English and French - Custom colors: background, text, secondary text, lines, bar track and accent; Minimal and Black & White styles PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) - Top N button: select the N values with the highest measure in one click - Paste a list: paste values from Excel, see which ones were found, replace or add to the…
